info.title: What US state bars charge, and require, to file or review lawyer advertising: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
What US state bars charge, and require, to file or review lawyer advertising: What each US state bar asks of a lawyer who advertises: whether ads or solicitations must be filed or reviewed, when, the standard, late and advisory fees, the portal or method, whether an expedited review exists, and how long copies must be kept. Every recorded field is backed by a short quote from the bar's or court's own rule or page, with the date read; a field we could not read from a primary source is marked unknown.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
